title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
description: A laundromat owner is pulled into a multiverse crisis and must reconnect with the people closest to her. It is a fast, imaginative science-fiction story with family drama at its centre.

title: The Holdovers
description: Over a winter break, a strict teacher, a grieving cook and a stranded student form an unexpected connection. It is a character-led comedy-drama with a warm, reflective tone.

title: The Banshees of Inisherin
description: A sudden end to a lifelong friendship unsettles two men on a small island. The film turns a simple break-up of companionship into a darkly comic and increasingly painful drama.

title: RRR
description: Two men with opposing public roles forge a powerful friendship during colonial rule in India. It is a large-scale action drama built around spectacle, music and emotional stakes.

title: 3 Idiots
description: Three engineering students challenge the pressure and expectations around academic success. The story balances campus comedy with questions about curiosity, ambition and friendship.

title: Dangal
description: A former wrestler trains his daughters to compete in a sport rarely open to them in their community. It is a family and sports drama about discipline, opportunity and determination.

title: The Lunchbox
description: A mistaken lunch delivery begins a private exchange between two strangers in Mumbai. The film is a quiet drama about routine, loneliness and the possibility of connection.

title: Kantara
description: A village conflict over land and tradition grows into a larger story shaped by local ritual and belief. It combines action, mystery and folklore in a rural setting.

title: Jallikattu
description: When a buffalo escapes into a village, an attempt to capture it exposes fear, rivalry and crowd instinct. This tense thriller turns a local emergency into social chaos.

title: The Wedding Party
description: A high-profile Lagos wedding brings families, friends and competing expectations into the same celebration. It is a social comedy built around romance, ceremony and family pressure.

title: Lionheart
description: A determined woman steps into her father’s transport business and faces resistance from those who doubt her. It is a family drama about leadership, responsibility and resilience.

title: King of Boys
description: A powerful businesswoman enters a dangerous political struggle while trying to hold on to influence and loyalty. It is a crime drama about power, ambition and consequence.

title: The Black Book
description: A grieving father searches for the truth after his son is accused of a crime. The thriller follows his path through corruption, loss and a dangerous demand for justice.

title: Eyimofe
description: Two Lagos residents prepare for a hoped-for future abroad while ordinary setbacks reshape their plans. It is a patient drama about work, migration, family and possibility.

title: Citation
description: A postgraduate student challenges the behaviour of a powerful lecturer at her university. The drama examines authority, evidence and the personal cost of speaking up.

title: Aníkúlápó
description: A traveller’s search for a new life takes an unexpected turn after he encounters a power tied to death and rebirth. It is a Yoruba-language fantasy drama rooted in moral choices.

title: Decision to Leave
description: A detective becomes drawn to a woman connected to a death he is investigating. The romantic mystery follows obsession, distance and the uncertainty of what can be known.

title: The Wailing
description: A rural police officer investigates a violent illness spreading through his village. The mystery moves between fear, faith and uncertainty as the threat grows closer to home.

title: Shoplifters
description: A family living at the edges of Tokyo takes in a young girl and confronts what family means beyond blood. It is an intimate drama about care, survival and belonging.

title: Drive My Car
description: A theatre director forms a quiet bond with the driver assigned to him while preparing a multilingual production. The drama explores grief, performance and difficult conversations.

title: The Social Network
description: A college student’s social-network project grows into a company while friendships and ownership fracture around it. It is a fast, dialogue-driven drama about ambition, invention and betrayal.

title: Whiplash
description: An ambitious young drummer enters the demanding world of an elite music conservatory. The intense drama asks what a person may sacrifice in pursuit of greatness.

title: The Nice Guys
description: A mismatched private investigator and enforcer investigate a missing person case in 1970s Los Angeles. The film blends mystery, action and deadpan comedy.

title: The Farewell
description: A writer returns to China when her family gathers around her ill grandmother while keeping difficult news from her. It is a gentle family story about love, culture and grief.

title: Past Lives
description: Two childhood friends reconnect years after one emigrates from South Korea. The quiet drama considers memory, identity and the lives shaped by choices.

title: Lagaan
description: Villagers facing a crushing colonial tax challenge their rulers to a cricket match despite having little experience of the game. It is a sports drama about solidarity and resistance.

title: Gully Boy
description: A young man from Mumbai finds a voice through rap while navigating family pressure and social expectations. The film follows creativity, friendship and the drive to be heard.

title: Tumbbad
description: A man’s search for a hidden fortune leads him deeper into a dangerous family legend. This period horror tale connects greed with a haunting folklore-inspired world.

title: Super Deluxe
description: Several lives intersect across one extraordinary day as families confront secrets, judgement and chance. The film moves between dark humour, drama and moral uncertainty.

title: Kumbalangi Nights
description: Four brothers living in a coastal village must confront their strained relationships when new people enter their lives. It is a warm but clear-eyed family drama.

title: October 1
description: A police officer investigates a murder in a newly independent Nigerian town. The period mystery uses one case to explore fear, power and social tension.

title: The Figurine
description: Friends find an ancient object said to bring good fortune before turning against them. The supernatural mystery explores belief, friendship and consequence.

title: 93 Days
description: Health workers and officials respond to an Ebola case in Lagos. The drama focuses on coordination, courage and the human stakes of a public-health emergency.

title: Merry Men
description: A group of wealthy friends in Abuja use charm and confidence to navigate romance and trouble. It is a glossy social comedy about friendship and consequences.

title: Brotherhood
description: Two brothers are separated by the choices they make around crime and survival. The crime drama follows loyalty, pressure and the cost of violence.

title: Memories of Murder
description: Detectives investigate a series of murders in a rural town while evidence and methods repeatedly fail them. The crime drama balances procedural tension with frustration and uncertainty.

title: A Taxi Driver
description: A Seoul taxi driver agrees to take a foreign journalist on a journey that changes his understanding of events in Gwangju. It is a historical drama about witness and responsibility.

title: The Handmaiden
description: A young woman joins an heiress’s household as part of a con, but shifting loyalties transform the plan. The period thriller is built on deception, desire and reversals.

title: Tokyo Story
description: An elderly couple visits their adult children in Tokyo and discovers how time and responsibility have changed family life. It is a restrained drama about generations and distance.

title: Perfect Blue
description: A pop idol leaves music for acting and begins to question what is real as pressure and obsession close in. This psychological animated thriller examines identity and image.
